en: Vintage monochrome postcard with a circular-framed waterside scene. In the foreground is a harbor with a sailing ship moored at the quay; in the background are multi‑story European stone buildings and a larger institutional building. People are visible along the waterfront. Decorative printed text in red at the top reads "Göteborg." Additional caption text in Swedish appears at the bottom, and there is a handwritten word near the lower right. The left margin has printed series information.
